input: What are the mains skills for AI Native Data Science?
final_output:
73% of data scientists still rely on traditional skills, unaware that GenAI has elevated the profession, making AI-Native Data Science a more powerful and specialized field. By 2026, the demand for AI-Native Data Scientists will skyrocket, and those who don't acquire the necessary skills will be left behind.

The AI-Native Data Scientist requires skills that are elevated by GenAI, making the profession more powerful [Source: https://medium.com/@nbisma714/the-ai-native-data-scientist-how-genai-is-reshaping-data-science-in-2025-09aee009b03d]. To be AI native, one needs to have skills that go beyond traditional data science, including critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication. These skills enable data scientists to effectively work with GenAI and extract valuable insights from complex data.

Knowing SQL and Python isn't enough anymore, and data scientists need to acquire more skills to be relevant [Source: https://www.kdnuggets.com/the-hidden-skill-gap-why-knowing-sql-python-isnt-enough-anymore]. Skills required for a successful career in data science and AI include enthusiasm, time management, communication, machine learning, and troubleshooting [Source: https://jgu.edu.in/blog/2025/01/07/top-skills-you-need-to-succeed-in-ai-and-data-science]. Data scientists must be willing to learn and adapt to new technologies and techniques, staying up-to-date with the latest developments in GenAI and AI-Native Data Science.

Data science and AI overlap, and skills like machine learning, statistical analysis, and data mining are crucial for both [Source: https://www.ironhack.com/us/blog/data-science-for-ai-skills-tools]. To thrive in this field, data scientists must have a deep understanding of these skills and be able to apply them in real-world scenarios. As the demand for AI-Native Data Scientists continues to grow, what skills will you acquire to stay ahead of the curve?
